description: Create or update the root `.gitignore` file for a JVM project (Java or Kotlin, Maven or Gradle, plain, Spring Boot or Quarkus) — compiled classes, logs, packaged artifacts (jar/war/ear/zip), JVM crash logs, the build tool's output directories (Maven `target/`; Gradle `build/`/`.gradle/` with the wrapper jar kept tracked), IntelliJ/.idea entries, and, when detected, Kotlin compiler caches (`.kotlin/`), Quarkus leftovers (`.quarkus/`, `quarkus.log`, stray `jacoco.exec`), the repository-wide `.integration-test.lock/` directory used to serialize container-backed test runs, and project-specific generated files such as a build-info properties file written by a Groovy/Maven plugin or an Antora docs build output directory. Invoke as `/iru-setup-java-gitignore`, optionally with `args` carrying `on-existing: ask|keep|update|replace` (default `ask`) for scripted runs. Announces whether it is creating `.gitignore` from scratch or updating an existing one; if one already exists, it never overwrites it silently: it warns, shows the proposed version as a diff, and asks whether to Update (merge, keeping hand-added entries), Keep it as is, or Replace it with the template (hand-added entries lost) — unless `on-existing` already decides. Ships with this repository's own `.gitignore` as the concrete reference template (genericized so its Hermes-specific paths don't leak into other repositories), reused across repositories. Use whenever a Java or Kotlin JVM project needs a `.gitignore` bootstrapped from scratch, or an existing one checked against this house template without touching it unless the user approves.
